name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.0.0: Read breaking-change footers into the store changelog.
changelog.v1.19.0: Set the radio's position, mute and remove nodes; Reboot, shut down and reset the radio; Keep both classes of Position edit, and mute once per press.
changelog.v1.18.0: Ask a node for its name, or have the radio ignore it; Trace the route to a node; Make the MQTT section editable; Make the Device, Position and Power sections editable; Show the mesh health the radio already reports; Never send a placeholder User when asking a node for its name (and 2 more).
changelog.v1.17.0: Pick an update channel and install from the About screen; Name the channel Automatic actually resolves to; Report the version project(VERSION) actually says.
changelog.v1.16.0: Pair PIN-mode nodes and manage the link from the Devices tab; Address review findings on the pairing path; Say why a message failed instead of just marking it failed.
